announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled interim results, providing shareholders with a periodic update on the company's financial performance and operational progress for the reporting period.

announcements.headline: Technical Cooperation Agreement
announcements.insight: Technical cooperation agreements are standard operational steps for junior miners to validate resource potential rather than immediate commercial milestones; without disclosed funding or offtake commitments, the market impact is limited to speculative exploration updates.

announcements.headline: Results of AGM
announcements.insight: This is a standard administrative filing confirming the outcome of routine shareholder votes at Harvest Minerals' AGM, which typically involves re-electing directors and approving fees rather than strategic shifts or capital raises.

announcements.headline: Completed acquisition of Scanty Mineracao & TVR
announcements.insight: This acquisition expands Harvest Minerals' lithium portfolio in Brazil, aligning with the broader sector trend of Western miners securing upstream supply to meet EV battery demand; however, the strategic value depends heavily on the grade and processing costs of the Scanty asset relative to current LME lithium carbonate prices.

announcements.headline: Acquisition of Brazilian Rare Earth Portfolio
announcements.insight: This acquisition diversifies Harvest Minerals' asset base into the high-growth rare earths sector, aligning with global supply chain decoupling trends and increasing demand for critical minerals in EV and defence applications.

announcements.headline: 2025 Final Results
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual financial results for the reporting period. Shareholders should anticipate detailed performance metrics and strategic updates within the full document.
